verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a SaaS work-management platform like Asana, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no retention policies, deletion controls, or data-lifecycle settings. The closest items are agent governance (scoped data access, audit trails) and AI Teammates' shared memory, which are adjacent features and not retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
